product.name: NILSOVE chair
product.note: Parts only: screws and fittings aren’t shown, and sizes are approximate. Each step names the page of your paper manual to follow.

steps.title: Start with 2 pieces
steps.instruction: Join 2 pieces (A, B), as the animation shows. Page 3 of the IKEA manual shows this step.

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the NILSOVE chair. Page 3 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (piece, about 57 cm), B (piece, about 42 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 82 cm tall.

steps.title: Add a piece
steps.instruction: Attach a piece (C) to what you have built so far, as the animation shows. Page 4 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
